seriesTitle: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing

episodes.title: Born Again at Bottom-Tier
episodes.summary: A hardcore gamer is reborn when he chooses to play on Hell Mode difficulty. Now he needs to figure out how his summoning skills work. While still a baby.

episodes.title: The Appraisal Ceremony
episodes.summary: Little does Allen know that the Appraisal Ceremony will expose the brutal reality of playing on Hell Mode.

episodes.title: Trouble
episodes.summary: Allen experiments with his Summoner abilities, unaware that a coming crisis will remind him that the world he treats as a game is a harsh reality for others.

episodes.title: Allen Spills the Beans
episodes.summary: Allen decides to tell his parents about his abilities.

episodes.title: A Summoner's Potential
episodes.summary: Allen's hunting strategies have paid off, but the fledgling summoner still has a long way to go. Especially when he must now deduce the purpose of his new storage skill.

episodes.title: Outward Bound
episodes.summary: The baron wishes to observe Allen's boar hunts firsthand. If he's impressed, there may even be a reward; one that could change both Allen and his family's life forever.

episodes.title: Life with the Granvelles
episodes.summary: Allen begins his new life as a manservant of the Gravelle Family. Fortunately for him, that doesn't mean the end of a life of monster hunting.

episodes.title: Huntsman
episodes.summary: Allen's uncanny ability to hunt monsters earns him a promotion, and the baron's family awaits a visit from the eldest son. Life is good. For now.

episodes.title: The Murdergalsh
episodes.summary: Allen realizes he's still got a long way to go after a B-rank monster attacks the city. If he wants to face the challenges ahead, he must unlock his class's true potential.

episodes.title: The Noble's Duty
episodes.summary: Allen may have figured out his class, but that doesn't mean he's figured out the world.

episodes.title: Sneak Attack
episodes.summary: Allen merely sees the Armored Ant colony as a test of his abilities. He has no idea that victory could lead to political consequences.

episodes.title: The Escape
episodes.summary: Allen and Cecil have a long, dangerous road ahead of them. Reaching safety means facing more than just one threat.

episodes.title: Off to Academy City
episodes.summary: Allen's new life in Academy City begins, but an appraisal ceremony unexpectedly puts him on Helmios the Hero's radar.

episodes.title: A New Friend
episodes.summary: The No-Life Gamers are off to a good start, but they face a few setbacks: their healer can't join full-time and Krena doesn't know how to use skills.

episodes.title: Conquer the Dungeon
episodes.summary: Keel officially joins the No-Life Gamers as they tackle a B-rank dungeon. But as they grow stronger, Allen uncovers a concerning issue regarding his new friend.

episodes.title: An Order from the Prince
episodes.summary: A-rank dungeons are dangerous for a reason, as the No-Life Gamers quickly learn. But that's not the only challenge awaiting them.

episodes.title: The Sovereign of Spirits' Prophecy
episodes.summary: A new school year brings big changes as three new members join the No-Life Gamers.

episodes.title: Showdown at the Academy Tournament!
episodes.summary: Allen faces off against the hero. If he wants to win, he'll have to use his new summoning abilities.

episodes.title: Onward to Rohzenheim
episodes.summary: As the Demon Lord's army lays waste to the Elven Kingdom of Rozenheim, Allen and his friends must find a way to repel the invasion before it's too late.

episodes.title: The Battle of Tiamo
episodes.summary: Allen has an unusual request for the Sovereign of Spirits: he wants all of his friends switched over to Hell Mode.

episodes.title: The Demons of Lapolka
episodes.summary: The No-Life Gamers must hold the line at Tiamo. But the longer the fighting drags on, the fewer magic stones remain at Allen's disposal.

episodes.title: Plentiful Prayers
episodes.summary: The odds are grim. If the No-Life Gamers want to liberate Lapolka, they'll need more than just strategy.

episodes.title: The Liberated
episodes.summary: One against a million. If Allen wants to even the odds, he'll have to put his new Deputize skill to the test.

episodes.title: Extra Skill
episodes.summary: Allen's party is determined to retake the Elven capital, regardless of what Helmios says.

episodes.title: Summoner of the Beginning
episodes.summary: Allen and his friends make their final stand against Rehzel.
